newsitem.title: JAPAN: BADMINTON-DENMARK'S UNSEEDED RASMUSSEN TAKES JAPAN OPEN TITLE.
newsitem.headline: BADMINTON-DENMARK'S UNSEEDED RASMUSSEN TAKES JAPAN OPEN TITLE.

text.p: Unseeded Dane Peter Rasmussen became the first European in seven years to win the men's singles title at the Japan Open badminton when he beat South Korean Park Sung-woo in the final on Sunday.

Indonesia's top-seeded Mia Audina, the Olympic silver medallist and world number one, survived a run of errors in the second set to win her first Japan Open women's singles title with an 11-3 2-11 11-5 defeat of second seed Gong Zhichao of China.
"I grew so tired that I gave up on taking the second set and started preparations for the third set," Audina, 17, said of her collapse in the second set.
Rasmussen, who beat triple Japan Open winner Ardi Wiranata of Indonesia on Saturday, had a much easier time against Park.
In an all-Indonesian men's doubles final, top seeds Rexy Mainaky and Ricky Subagdja pulled off a 15-11 7-15 15-7 win over Antoniuss and Denny Kantono.
In the women's doubles final, second-seeded Gu Jun and Ge Fei of China rallied to beat number one seeds Eliza and Zelin Resiana of Indonesia 12-15 15-12 15-1.
